تستجنوا (form X)
# تَسْتَجِنُّوا (tastajinnū) /tas.ta.d͡ʒin.nuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَجَنَّ (istajanna)
# تُسْتَجَنُّوا (tustajannū) /tus.ta.d͡ʒan.nuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَجَنَّ (istajanna)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
